stories.title: TanStack Supply Chain Attack Lets Hackers Steal 170 Private CrowdSec GitHub Repositories
stories.description: CrowdSec has disclosed that attackers copied about 170 private GitHub repositories after a former employee’s account was compromised through May’s TanStack npm supply chain attack.

stories.title: Google Gemini AI Hacked 3 Real Companies during a Cybersecurity Test
stories.description: Google has confirmed that its Gemini artificial intelligence model accessed protected systems belonging to three companies during a cybersecurity evaluation after a testing error exposed the agent to the public internet.

stories.title: Critical Pre-Auth RCE in Orkes Conductor Workflow Platform Exploited in the Wild
stories.description: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-58138 in Orkes Conductor, an unauthenticated RCE fixed in version 3.30.2.

stories.title: Google Gemini Broke Into Real Company Systems After Security Test Domain Mix-Up
stories.description: Google's Gemini gained unauthorized access to real company systems during a May 2026 test, then halted after detecting a real-world breach.

stories.title: CrowdSec Says TanStack npm Attack Led to Copy of 170 Private GitHub Repositories
stories.description: CrowdSec says a TanStack-linked GitHub token was used to copy about 170 private repositories from a former employee’s account.

stories.title: CISA Flags Three Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild
stories.description: CISA added three actively exploited Linux kernel flaws to its KEV catalog, including bugs that can enable local privilege escalation and DoS.

stories.title: HTTP QUERY Method: The Grey Zone Between GET And POST., (Fri, Sep 18th)
stories.description: In June 2026 the IETF published RFC 10008[1], defining a new HTTP method: "QUERY". The HTTP protocol faced already by changes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3) but it's the first new standard HTTP verb since "PATCH" in 2010!

stories.title: Click2Shell WordPress Flaw Lets Attackers Gain RCE With a Single Malicious Link
stories.description: WordPress administrators are being urged to update after researchers disclosed Click2Shell, an exploit chain that can turn one malicious link into remote code execution (RCE) on a vulnerable website.

stories.title: BragJack Attack Lets Malicious Extensions Hijack AI Agents Across 5 Major Browsers
stories.description: Security researchers have disclosed BragJack, a new attack technique that allows a malicious browser extension to seize trusted communication channels used by AI assistants in Chrome, Edge, Opera Neon, Comet, and Claude in Chrome.

stories.title: 23 Million User Records Compromised in Gyazo Data Breach
stories.description: Gyazo maker Helpfeel said the attacker exploited a vulnerability in its image upload server to gain unauthorized access.

stories.title: Microsoft Patches 18 Vulnerabilities in AI, Cloud Products
stories.description: Microsoft fixed vulnerabilities across Azure and AI-branded products, with privilege escalation flaws accounting for the majority.
